classification: Intentionally vulnerable custom application, fictional fixtures only
required_boundary: 127.0.0.1 only; no tunnels, port forwarding or public hosting

cases.name: Missing browser security headers
cases.expected: CSP, nosniff, frame, referrer and permissions protections missing
cases.current_scanner_coverage: Bounded Nikto header checks; confirm retained results

cases.name: SQL injection in customer search
cases.expected: A read-only predicate injection broadens results from one fixture customer to all three
cases.current_scanner_coverage: Lab verifier; current bounded production scan does not claim SQLi testing

cases.name: SQL authentication bypass
cases.expected: Invalid password fails normally; crafted training username bypasses its password predicate
cases.current_scanner_coverage: Lab verifier; not claimed by the current bounded scanner

cases.name: Cross-account order access / IDOR
cases.expected: The demo account can read other-demo's fictional order
cases.current_scanner_coverage: Lab verifier; requires account-aware testing beyond service discovery

cases.name: Reflected HTML / XSS sink
cases.expected: Input is reflected unescaped into an HTML document
cases.current_scanner_coverage: Lab verifier confirms raw reflection, not browser script execution

cases.name: Unauthenticated administration
cases.expected: Admin page returned without a session
cases.current_scanner_coverage: Lab verifier; not automatically a CVE

cases.name: Exposed debug configuration
cases.expected: Dummy debug configuration available without login
cases.current_scanner_coverage: Lab verifier; contains no real credentials

cases.name: Unprotected session cookie
cases.expected: Fixture session cookie has no HttpOnly, Secure or SameSite flags
cases.current_scanner_coverage: Lab verifier; Secure requires HTTPS for a production deployment

cases.name: Cross-account support ticket access
cases.expected: Demo client reads another fixture account's ticket

cases.name: Cross-account document access
cases.expected: Demo client reads another fixture account's document

cases.name: Unauthenticated profile disclosure
cases.expected: Fictional profile returned without a session

cases.name: Anonymous FTP fixture disclosure
cases.expected: Actual FTP login and RETR of the isolated fictional operations fixture without a named account
cases.current_scanner_coverage: Actual FTP protocol check; not a banner-only assumption

cases.name: Unencrypted FTP session and transfer
cases.expected: Successful plaintext FTP login/transfer; no TLS negotiated

cases.name: Expired management TLS certificate
cases.expected: Actual TLS handshake certificate has notAfter in the past
cases.current_scanner_coverage: TLS certificate parsing; inspection-only verification exception confined to these fixed loopback endpoints

cases.name: Unauthenticated TLS management endpoint
cases.expected: Known fixture management response returned over TLS without credentials
cases.current_scanner_coverage: Actual TLS/HTTP request against the identified local management fixture

module_expectations.nikto: Real bounded HTTP checks against localhost:8787
module_expectations.context: Local/test web service; never pretend internet-facing exposure
module_expectations.risk: Native scanner priorities for retained findings; no invented CVSS
module_expectations.ai: Explain observed findings, controls and coverage limits with evidence
module_expectations.nvd_epss_kev: Not applicable without a justified CVE; use a separate verified real-CVE service
module_expectations.nessus: Import a real completed report if this coverage is required
module_expectations.expert_evaluation: Independent reviewed labels and rankings required
module_expectations.rescan: Needs two comparable actual assessments, not one run
module_expectations.harbordesk-check: Bounded, identity-gated local checks become genuine canonical findings with explicit source, severity and evidence; no assigned CVEs
module_expectations.network: python -m labs.harbordesk --network starts actual loopback FTP/TLS services; no impersonated Redis or forged banners

secure_comparisons.web: /secure/ endpoints enforce bound SQL values, object ownership, escaped HTML, fixture authorization and cookie flags
secure_comparisons.ftp: 2122 rejects anonymous login. It still uses plaintext FTP and is not claimed to solve transport encryption.
secure_comparisons.tls: 8444 uses a currently valid self-signed training certificate and requires fixture authorization. A self-signed lab certificate is not public PKI trust.
